name: Bleed
short: At the start of the Refresh Phase, take 1 damage.

name: Stunned
short: Remove all Energy. Cannot gain Energy. Cannot gain Stunned if already Stunned.

name: Shield
short: Spend when declared the target of an attack to gain +1 Defense for that attack. Max 1. Not removed during Refresh.

name: Stealth
short: Cannot be targeted by attacks. Remove when this unit makes an attack. Max 1.

name: Heat
short: Track heat from fire abilities. Resolve per card text.

name: Exposed
short: Unit is exposed. Resolve per card text.
